But the design details matter enormously, arguably more than the question of whether to regulate at all. Rules should be proportionate to actual capability and risk, updated as the technology evolves, and developed with input from industry, independent researchers, and civil society. Getting that balance right — safety without strangling beneficial innovation — is the genuinely hard part, and it's where most of the live debate actually is.
